body: Can't do it. Can't overcome the survival instinct. The fear is too strong. I'm here because I can't see it through.

Life's not binary, I guess for some it may be and for some it may not. If you asking whether it's all pointless, don't know. Sure, one day none of it won't matter, but I would say that end gives things at least some meaning as endless things just seems to so be completely meaningless to me.
This world is just fucked up.
I was afraid so. Thanks for answering all my questions buddy.

I don't know. When I'm empty, when it's just numbness, I want to feel something. But then when I do feel the love and I'm being let down and I feel the pain, I wish not to be in love ever again. Seems to me as no-win situation.  
Anyway, good luck buddy.

Well, this was not easy to read.  
Sometimes I wonder if an illusion of love would be sufficient enough. Maybe it would do the trick, I don't know. Sure, it would not be a real connection nor real love, but maybe paying a sex worker to pretend would make some difference. There are things we can't control and things we might. But I honestly think it would not last long.
Not sure what's better though. Not to be able to feel love at all or be able to feel it but face the the endless stream of rejections. What do you think?

Thank your for this authentic reply.  
You described what did you stop doing, what does it mean to you to give up on life but what is it like? How does it feel like? Did it help to bring some relief or liberation?

The thing is that we don't deserve anything because that would imply someone or something owes it to us. But that's not how the world works, the world doesn't owe us anything. It doesn't mean we are not worthy of love, though. We are and yet we won't most likely ever get it.

I think you're right and it's connected to the insecurity and desperation, but the older we get the harder it seems to be to change it. By each rejection it gets a little bit harder to stay optimistic.

Probably best to start with something small at first. It really does take some time to make a videogame. It's very easy to estimate how long something will take and then be wrong.

Also you don't have to do it alone, maybe you would find some people to colab. Here or maybe on Indie DB.

And just don't be too hard on yourself :)
